principle: IsoPixel and Voxel are deterministic coordinate projections of canonical PixelMap addresses. The typed Mandala address remains authority.

iso2D.validity: u and v must have equal parity; planeId is carried separately
iso2D.note: This is a lattice transform, not a perspective rendering.

zLaw.MF: z = layer0 (0..5) when using sector-lattice view; y may be 0 in the voxel view

voxel.alternativeMFMapping: (x=sector0,y=0,z=layer0) preserves the 72×6 cylinder as six stacked cyclic rings.

isoFromVoxel.authority: RENDER_ONLY unless original {planeId,x,y,z} is retained alongside u,v

cylindricalMandalaRender.note: Useful for drawing the Mandala, never for canonical decoding because floating-point geometry is not the identity layer.

seamLaw: SEC/MF x=71 and x=0 are adjacent even if a flat or isometric render shows a seam.
